hero.title: Desheng Drum
hero.subtitle: Suona melodies and percussion tell the story of a victory

videoHint: Video playback may use significant data — Wi-Fi recommended
paras: Desheng Drum (literally “Victory Drum”) is a Wanzai folk music tradition that took shape during the Northern Song dynasty. Its nine-part suite follows a Tang dynasty story about the defeat of the An Lushan Rebellion.

A suona, a loud double-reed wind instrument, leads the ensemble alongside drums, gongs and cymbals. The music moves from brisk, light passages to forceful drumming, and players use the suona to imitate the sound of horses.
The music is traditionally heard at weddings, festivals and other celebrations. In 2008, China added the Wanzai tradition to its national intangible cultural heritage list under suona music.
